site.name: Hotel Silver Pearl
site.tagline: A modern seaside stay in Kuakata
site.shortDescription: A contemporary hotel a few minutes from Kuakata Sea Beach, with refined rooms, buffet breakfast and warm Bangladeshi hospitality.

home.heroTitle: Where the Bay of Bengal meets quiet luxury
home.heroSubtitle: Family-run, freshly built and a short walk from one of the few beaches in the world where you can watch both sunrise and sunset over the sea.
home.introTitle: Stay close to the sea, far from the noise
home.introBody: Hotel Silver Pearl is a newly opened, owner-operated property in the heart of Kuakata. Glass-front facade, calm interiors and balconies that look over the coconut trees — we kept the design simple so the coast can do the talking.
home.roomsSubtitle: Three categories, all with buffet breakfast included.
home.locationBody: Kuakata, Patuakhali — about an hour from Patuakhali town and reachable from Dhaka by bus or launch via Barisal.
home.ctaBody: Message us on WhatsApp for the fastest reply, or fill out the contact form and we'll get back within a few hours.

rooms.pageSubtitle: All rates are per room, per night, in Bangladeshi Taka. Net amount already includes the discount, service charge and VAT.

familyDeluxe.name: Family Deluxe
familyDeluxe.summary: Spacious room with one king bed and a single bed, marble accent wall, large window, balcony view.

superDeluxe.name: Super Deluxe
superDeluxe.summary: Quiet, well-lit room for two, soft furnishing, work desk and a view of the surrounding coconut trees.

deluxe.name: Deluxe
deluxe.summary: Comfortable room for two with floor-to-ceiling windows, fresh linens and all essentials.

amenities.pageSubtitle: Everything we provide so you can settle in and head straight for the beach.

gallery.pageSubtitle: Photos of the building, signage, rooms, interior and dining area.

location.pageSubtitle: Hotel Silver Pearl, Kuakata, Patuakhali — Bangladesh.
location.byBusBody: Direct overnight buses run from Gabtoli, Sayedabad and Kallyanpur to Kuakata. Travel time is roughly 8–10 hours.
location.byLaunchBody: Take an overnight launch from Sadarghat to Barisal, then a 4–5 hour bus to Kuakata via Patuakhali.
location.byCarBody: Drive from Dhaka via the Padma Bridge — around 7–8 hours depending on traffic. Free parking is available on-site.

contact.pageSubtitle: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us. The booking form below sends your details straight into a WhatsApp chat.
